# A Song Told in Words Alone
- artist: The Fixture Trio

## Verse
The rain came down on the long grey road
and nobody minded the weather;
we walked with our coats on our shoulders
and sang to the gulls all together.

## Second verse
The sun came out by the harbour wall
and nobody minded the hour;
we sat with our feet in the water
and gave every boat a flower.
